Run the unit suite with:

```
make test-fast
```

It skips the Postgres and network integration tests. To run everything, use `make test`. That needs the database up first, so run `docker compose up db` before it.

Both targets are in the `Makefile`. The commands come from a stored project note, and I only checked that the two targets exist. I didn't run either one.
